security: The run pass is a new optional repository secret passed only to the fetch step, not into the set-up gate loop. It travels only in a POST body to api.kartaan.com and is never printed or stored. The extension gets one host permission (api.kartaan.com) and stores the pass in its own local storage key, shown back only as saved or not saved. Existing repositories without a pass carry on unchecked (flagged for Control).
